doan: {Yesterday||yesterday} {afternoon||afternoon}, the {weather||weather} was cool and bright in Kotoba Village. Mr. Oakley walked near the river because he wanted fresh air. Red and yellow leaves fell from every tree.

Ben the postman met Mr. Oakley near the old {bridge||bridge}. Ben carried a big {bag||bag} of {letters||letter}. They stopped and {talked||talk} about the {sea||sea} and autumn {flowers||flower}. It was a quiet {week||week} in the {village||village}.

bai.tieu_de: A New Friend at the Café
doan: Linh arrived in Kotoba Village this week. She got a job at The Kettle Café with Hana. Linh wants to learn English, so she talks to every customer. Yesterday, she served {tea||tea} and hot {water||water} to Mr. Oakley.

Suddenly, StackChan ran into the {small||small} café. The little robot carried a picture of an {apple||apple}. "Look at my art!" shouted StackChan happily. Linh smiled, but then she {dropped||drop} a cup on the {floor||floor}. Hana walked out of the kitchen and looked at Linh.
◆ The village {bus||bus} will arrive late tomorrow morning because of the {cloud||cloud} and rain. Please wait at the {shop||shop}.
◆ Join us this {weekend||weekend} for autumn tea near the river garden. Bring your favorite cup and enjoy delicious cake with friends!

cau_hoi.hoi: Why did Mr. Oakley walk near the river?
chon: Because he wanted to buy a bus ticket.
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Trong bài tin làng có câu: 'Mr. Oakley walked near the river because he wanted fresh air.'

cau_hoi.hoi: What did Linh drop on the floor?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Trong bài truyện có câu: 'Linh smiled, but then she dropped a cup on the floor.'

cau_hoi.hoi: Where should villagers wait for the bus tomorrow morning?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Trong phần thông báo có câu: 'Please wait at the shop.'

tom_tat: Số báo đầu tiên cập nhật không khí mùa thu thanh bình ở làng Kotoba, khởi đầu công việc của Linh tại quán cà phê The Kettle Café và một vài thông báo làng.
